nodes.name: __init__.py (server_script)
nodes.summary: Empty init file for the server_script DocType package.

nodes.name: server_script.js
nodes.summary: Client-side form controller for Server Script DocType. Sets up autocompletion for the script code editor, checks if safe exec is enabled, provides inline help with code examples for DocType Events, API calls, Permission Queries, and Workflow Tasks, and adds a Compare Versions button.

nodes.name: server_script.py
nodes.summary: Core Python controller for Server Script DocType. Implements execution of user-defined scripts for DocType events, API endpoints, scheduler events, permission queries, and workflow tasks. Uses RestrictedPython for sandboxed execution via safe_exec.

nodes.name: ServerScript
nodes.summary: Document controller for Server Script DocType. Manages lifecycle (validate, on_update, on_trash), syncs Scheduled Job Types for scheduler scripts, validates script compilation with RestrictedPython, and provides execute methods for API, doc event, scheduler, permission query, and workflow task script types.

nodes.name: ServerScript.validate
nodes.summary: Validates that the current user has Script Manager role and checks if the script compiles in restricted context.

nodes.name: ServerScript.sync_scheduled_job_type
nodes.summary: Creates or updates Scheduled Job Type documents when a Server Script of type 'Scheduler Event' is saved. Handles frequency changes, cron format updates, and script type transitions.

nodes.name: ServerScript.execute_method
nodes.summary: Executes API-type Server Scripts with optional rate limiting. Wraps execution in rate_limit decorator if enabled, otherwise calls execute_api_server_script directly.

nodes.name: ServerScript.execute_doc
nodes.summary: Executes a DocType Event Server Script in the context of a given document, with commit/rollback restrictions.

nodes.name: ServerScript.execute_scheduled_method
nodes.summary: Executes Scheduler Event Server Scripts. Raises DoesNotExistError if script type is not Scheduler Event.

nodes.name: ServerScript.get_permission_query_conditions
nodes.summary: Executes Permission Query Server Scripts to generate dynamic SQL conditions for list filtering based on user context.

nodes.name: ServerScript.execute_workflow_task
nodes.summary: Executes Workflow Task Server Scripts in the context of a document being acted upon by a workflow action.

nodes.name: get_autocompletion_items
nodes.summary: Whitelisted cached endpoint that generates autocompletion strings from the safe_exec context dictionary for use in the Server Script code editor.

nodes.name: execute_api_server_script
nodes.summary: Executes an API-type Server Script after validating script type and guest permissions. Returns the flags set during safe execution.

nodes.name: enabled
nodes.summary: Whitelisted endpoint that checks whether safe_exec (Server Scripts feature) is enabled on the current site.

nodes.name: server_script_utils.py
nodes.summary: Utility module for Server Scripts providing the EVENT_MAP constant that maps document lifecycle hooks to Server Script event names, and functions to run server scripts for doc events and build/cache the server script map.

nodes.name: EVENT_MAP
nodes.summary: Dictionary mapping Python document lifecycle hook names (e.g., 'before_insert', 'on_update') to their corresponding Server Script event labels (e.g., 'Before Insert', 'After Save'). Covers 21 events including payment processing hooks.

nodes.name: run_server_script_for_doc_event
nodes.summary: Entry point called from Document lifecycle to execute all matching Server Scripts for a given document event. Skips execution during install/migrate. Looks up scripts from the cached server script map.

nodes.name: get_server_script_map
nodes.summary: Builds and caches a map of all enabled Server Scripts organized by type: DocType events keyed by doctype and event, permission queries keyed by doctype, and API methods keyed by method path. Uses client_cache for persistence.

nodes.name: test_server_script.py
nodes.summary: Comprehensive integration tests for Server Script DocType covering DocType events (before insert, after rename), API endpoints, permission queries, syntax validation, commit restrictions in doc events, query builder restrictions, nested script calls, rate limiting, scheduled job creation/updates, and script state transitions.

nodes.name: TestServerScript
nodes.summary: Integration test class for Server Scripts with 13 test methods. Sets up test scripts for DocType events, API calls, and permission queries. Tests include validation, commit restrictions, QBuilder restrictions, nested scripts, rate limiting, scheduled jobs, and state transitions.
